lines.text: You're new in town and you need a haircut.
lines.caps: You're new in town | and you need a haircut.

lines.text: There are only two barbers.
lines.caps: There are only | two barbers.

lines.text: Which one do you choose?
lines.caps: Which one | do you choose?

lines.text: The first shop is spotless.
lines.caps: The first shop | is spotless.

lines.text: The floor is swept, the mirrors shine,
lines.caps: The floor is swept, | the mirrors shine,

lines.text: and the barber himself has a perfect, sharp haircut.
lines.caps: and the barber himself | has a perfect, | sharp haircut.

lines.text: The second shop is a mess.
lines.caps: The second shop | is a mess.

lines.text: Hair everywhere, a cracked mirror,
lines.caps: Hair everywhere, | a cracked mirror,

lines.text: and the barber's own hair looks terrible.
lines.caps: and the barber's own hair | looks terrible.

lines.text: Most people pick the first barber.
lines.caps: Most people pick | the first barber.

lines.text: But that's the wrong choice.
lines.caps: But that's | the wrong choice.

lines.text: Here's why.
lines.caps: Here's why.

lines.text: There are only two barbers in town.
lines.caps: There are only | two barbers in town.

lines.text: Barbers can't cut their own hair.
lines.caps: Barbers can't cut | their own hair.

lines.text: So who gave the first barber his perfect haircut?
lines.caps: So who gave | the first barber | his perfect haircut?

lines.text: The second barber.
lines.caps: The second barber.

lines.text: And who gave the second barber that terrible haircut?
lines.caps: And who gave | the second barber | that terrible haircut?

lines.text: The first one.
lines.caps: The first one.

lines.text: So the messy barber is actually the skilled one.
lines.caps: So the messy barber | is actually | the skilled one.

lines.text: His shop is messy because he's busy.
lines.caps: His shop is messy | because he's busy.

lines.text: Everyone smart goes to him.
lines.caps: Everyone smart | goes to him.

lines.text: The lesson? Don't judge someone by their appearance.
lines.caps: The lesson? | Don't judge someone | by their appearance.

lines.text: Judge them by their work.
lines.caps: Judge them | by their work.

lines.text: Did you get it right? Tell me in the comments.
lines.caps: Did you get it right? | Tell me | in the comments.

lines.text: And if you like puzzles like this, then make sure to follow our page, Things Explained.
lines.caps: And if you like | puzzles like this, | then make sure | to follow our page, | Things Explained.
